summary: Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 2 to its business combination agreement with Pasqal Holding SAS (French quantum computing firm). The amendment revises the post-combination board composition to 9 directors (5 must be French/European non-U.S. residents) and adjusts the equity incentive plan terms. This is a de-SPAC transaction, with Bleichroeder as the blank-check issuer. No price/share, premium, or close date are stated; the filing focuses on governance modifications. Watch for shareholder vote timing and any redemptions, as typical SPAC risk-arb centers on deal completion and trust account dynamics.
